summary: Iteration 6 post-refactor regression pass (code-quality-only refactor of backend helpers _map_row/_build_context/_ai_analysis/_run_resolved_sync and frontend hooks/components). Ran full backend pytest suite serially: 139/140 pass; the one failure (tests/test_iteration5.py::TestAIConfigGet::test_get_returns_gemini_masked) is a stale assertion from iteration 5 that was asserting provider=='gemini' — env was actually openai/gpt-4o-mini at test time; after tests I restored AI to the requested gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview/max_tokens=4000/use_emergent_key=false/rate_limit=10 so that test would now pass on re-run. New suite tests/test_iteration6.py (9 tests, all pass): historical/import _map_row mapping (INCQ001 tags 'confidence:0.77'+'category:Network', short_description, empty description, tags string 'a, b;c' → ['a','b','c'], missing number returns error 'missing number'), RCA import auto-titles 'RCA - INCQ003' when title omitted, /incidents/sn_inc_0001/similar in demo mode returns historical INC0089123+INC001 with score>0, kb includes 'Playbook: Core Payment API 504 timeouts' and rcas include 'RCA - INC0089123 Payment API 504', analyze returns valid 200 (or friendly 424 — never 500), sync/run with admin test user bound → 200 ok:false error 'ServiceNow credentials required' (or 'not configured' if instance_url was blanked by prior demo test), unbound sync returns 400. Frontend flows all verified: admin /incidents banner + auto-open dialog, save-then-remove creds toggles indicator amber; end-user demo mode shows 8 rows, search 'payment' narrows to 1, P1 narrows to 4, pagination shows 'Page 1 / 1', incident detail renders title/similar-panel/analyze-quota, back works; admin CRUD pages after crudPages refactor render (/admin/applications, /admin/kb with kb-upload-zone+kb-import-btn, /admin/rca with rca-import-btn, /admin/historical with historical-import-btn+hist-count, /admin/servicenow with sync-panel+sync-last-result, /admin/feedback chart, /admin/analyses row expands to linked-evidence), each 'New' button opens a create dialog, ZERO pageerrors on any admin page. Logout returns to /login with no crash. Response body for POST /analyze in demo mode returned 424 (Gemini quota exhausted on owner key) — friendly path, not a code defect. Final state restored: servicenow.instance_url=https://dev414250.service-now.com, ai=gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview/use_emergent_key=false/max_tokens=4000/rate_limit=10, sn_sync bound to owner user_33ad5ed974a9, admin test user has no SN creds, TEST_ historical/rca rows deleted, sessions re-seeded (logout revoked test_session_admin_001 during frontend logout test — re-seeded via /app/backend/tests/seed_test_sessions.py).

minor.issue: tests/test_iteration5.py::TestAIConfigGet::test_get_returns_gemini_masked hard-asserts provider=='gemini' — brittle to env drift (iteration 5 note already flagged this). Now passes because AI is restored, but should xfail-if-env-differs or read expected provider from config fixture.
Owner Gemini key is quota-exhausted upstream (real 429 → 424 friendly). Not a defect; UI handles gracefully.
No obvious cache but state can be silently blanked by concurrent test cleanup runs — consider ETag/version stamp so front-end/tests can detect racy writes.

action_items: OPTIONAL: convert tests/test_iteration5.py::test_get_returns_gemini_masked to read expected provider from a fixture so it doesn't fail if AI config drifts.
OPTIONAL: display a persistent hint on /admin/ai when Gemini quota is exhausted (current friendly toast only shows once per Analyze click).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew again during refactor (helpers extracted but all still in one 1200+ line file) — split into routers/services/models modules to stay under the 700-line guideline.
_map_row silently pads missing priority to '3' — good default, but no validation error is surfaced when caller passes garbage priority strings; consider allow-list.
Historical import errors are returned as list of dicts [{row,error}] while some other bulk endpoints return list of strings — normalize the shape for the frontend to render consistently.

sync/run returns HTTP 200 with ok:false on credential errors AND HTTP 400 when unbound — asymmetric. Prefer 400/424 in both cases (structured error) so the client doesn't have to branch on body vs status.

Frontend /incidents/[id] Analyze error persists the fallback 'AI analysis unavailable: …' record with status='error' (iteration 5 already flagged) — still present after refactor; consider a separate collection or a UI filter that hides status=='error' rows by default in /admin/analyses.
